00069 void LagUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00070 {
00071   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00072   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00073   float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00074   float* lagSamples = inputs[LagTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00075   float newLagTime = *lagSamples;
00076   
00077   ugen_assert(newLagTime >= 0.f);
00078   
00079   if(newLagTime != currentLagTime)
00080   {
00081     float next_b1 = newLagTime == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 / (newLagTime * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00082     float b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00083     
00084     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00085     {
00086       b1 += b1_slope;
00087       float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00088       *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1 * (y1 - y0));
00089     }
00090     
00091     b1 = next_b1;
00092     currentLagTime = newLagTime;
00093   }
00094   else
00095   {
00096     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00097     {
00098       float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00099       *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1 * (y1 - y0));
00100     }
00101   }
00102   
00103   y1 = zap(y1); // denormal!
00104 }

00113 void LagUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00114 {

00116   unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;

00121   float newLagTime = *lagSamples;
00122   
00123   ugen_assert(newLagTime >= 0.f);

00125   int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00126   
00127   if(newLagTime != currentLagTime)
00128   {
00129     float next_b1 = newLagTime == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 * krBlockSize / (newLagTime * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00130     float b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) * krBlockSize / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00131     currentLagTime = newLagTime; 
00132         
00133     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00134     {
00135       float nextValue = value;
00136       if(numKrSamples == 0)     
00137       {
00138         b1 += b1_slope;
00139         float y0 = *inputSamples; 
00140         nextValue = y1 = (y0 + b1 * (y1 - y0));
00141       }

00144

00149       {
00150         while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00151         {
00152           *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00153           --numSamplesToProcess;
00154           --numKrSamples;
00155         }
00156       } 
00157       else

00162         {

00167         }
00168

00170       }
00171     }
00172     
00173     b1 = next_b1;
00174   }

00176   {

00180       if(numKrSamples == 0)

00265 void LagUDUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00266 {
00267   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00268   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00269   float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00270   float* lagUpSamples = inputs[LagTimeUp].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00271   float* lagDownSamples = inputs[LagTimeDown].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00272   float newLagTimeUp = *lagUpSamples;
00273   float newLagTimeDown = *lagDownSamples;
00274   
00275   ugen_assert(newLagTimeUp >= 0.f);
00276   ugen_assert(newLagTimeDown >= 0.f);
00277   
00278   if((newLagTimeUp != currentLagTimeUp) || (newLagTimeDown != currentLagTimeDown))
00279   {
00280     float next_b1u = newLagTimeUp == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 / (newLagTimeUp * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00281     float next_b1d = newLagTimeDown == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 / (newLagTimeDown * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00282     float slope = 1.f / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00283     float b1u_slope = (next_b1u - b1u) * slope;
00284     float b1d_slope = (next_b1d - b1d) * slope;
00285     currentLagTimeUp = newLagTimeUp;
00286     currentLagTimeDown = newLagTimeDown;
00287     
00288     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00289     {
00290       b1u += b1u_slope;
00291       b1d += b1d_slope;
00292       float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00293       
00294       if (y0 > y1)
00295         *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1u * (y1 - y0));
00296       else
00297         *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1d * (y1 - y0));
00298     }
00299     
00300     b1u = next_b1u;
00301     b1d = next_b1d;
00302   }
00303   else
00304   {
00305     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00306     {
00307       float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00308       if (y0 > y1)
00309         *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1u * (y1 - y0));
00310       else
00311         *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1d * (y1 - y0));
00312     }
00313   }
00314   
00315   y1 = zap(y1); // denormal!
00316 }
